caption:
Loden is often called felt, but it is woven first and then fulled until the weave disappears.

Soaked in hot water and soap and pounded, the cloth thickens and keeps out wind and water. Green loden was long worn by huntsmen and foresters in Germany and Austria. The classic Hubertus coat has a doubled shoulder, leather football buttons and is traditionally unlined. The Duke of Edinburgh wore one often.

Connected to Tyrol, Lodenfrey, the Duke of Edinburgh, the covert coat and Tracht.
